newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman ups Teledata.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman ups Teledata.

text.p: -- Lehman analyst Tim Luke said he raised his rating on Teledata Communications Ltd to buy from outperform following a vist to the company's facilities in Israel and set a new 12-month price target of $30 on the stock.
-- The analyst said he continues to believe that his estimates remain conservative. He introduced a 1998 earnings estimate of $1.17 per share.
-- In published comments, the analyst said he believes the company is experiencing "extremely strong sales momentum" in the current fourth quarter.
-- His previous stock price target was $23.
